title: Learner 01 | Day 008: Lists and safe iteration
body:
## Goal

Store five session lengths and print their total and the last two sessions.

## Learn this first

A list holds ordered values. A for loop visits items; indexing starts at zero and slicing excludes its end.

## Method signature and expected behavior

**File:** `src/learnforge/core/operations/sessions.py`

**Function/class/value to change:** module-level `recent_sessions` values/statements in the provided starter scaffold

**Why here:** This is a domain/application decision: it expresses the calculation or use-case behavior while depending on values and small collaborator contracts.

**Inputs and expected outputs:** [10,20,30] totals 60 and its last two are [20,30]; empty list is handled.

**Boundaries:** Apply the rule once; use accepted values, not transport parsing or printing.
